title: My love for pokemon and Tower defense, combined!
author: Background-Pay5502
selftext:
I just want to share the game that I am currently working on. It still has some rough edges, but I am open to your feedback and suggestions. 

This game was inspired by Pokémon, where I want to create a monster-to-monster dynamic. The towers will evolve (upgrade), it has also concept of elements, where certain elements are stronger against enemies or where enemies have resistances. For now, it resembles a classic tower defense game and isn't as complicated as Bloons TD, which I really love and from which I also drew inspiration.

All towers and enemies are 3D mesh assets rendered in Blender and run on the Unity engine. 

I look forward to your constructive criticism! 😊
